watch.help: Notifies the chosen channels when this node is heard, and when it is back after a long silence.
watch.full: Limit reached ({{max}} watched nodes). Remove one in Settings > Notifications.
watch.noChannel: No channel is selected: nothing will be sent.
watch.loadFailed: Could not load the notification settings.

watched.title: Watched nodes
watched.help: Notify a channel when a watched node is heard or comes back after a long silence. Watch a node from its contact sheet.
watched.summary: every {{cooldown}} min at most · back after {{silence}} h
watched.dialogHelp: At most one notification per cooldown, plus a “back” one after a long silence.
watched.channelsHelp: Web Push reaches administrators’ devices only.
watched.cooldownHelp: After a notification, this node stays quiet for this long (1 minute at least, 30 days at most).
watched.silenceHelp: A sighting after at least this long without hearing the node is reported as back.
